jezero_crater_mars.name: Jezero Crater (Mars 2020 Perseverance Site)
jezero_crater_mars.mission_context: NASA Mars 2020 / Perseverance Rover - Astrobiology & Paleolake Exploration
key_scientific_questions: Preservation of biosignatures in ancient lacustrine sediments and deltaic clays.
Evaporite precipitation cycles and saline paleolake chemical evolution.
Autonomous rover traverse over mixed sand ripples and rocky bedrock.

gale_crater_mars.name: Gale Crater & Mount Sharp (MSL Curiosity Site)

Wheel traction degradation and tire abrasion on sharp ventifact-strewn bedrock.

analogs.name: Salar de Uyuni
analogs.scientific_summary: The world's largest salt flat (10,582 km²). Hyper-flat polygonal halite crust overlying dense brine. Pristine planetary analog for ancient closed-basin evaporite deposits on Mars (such as Jezero Crater and Meridiani Planum) and the premier Earth target for satellite laser and radar altimeter calibration (ICESat, MOLA).
analogs.geological_context: Pleistocene paleolake basin (Lake Minchin / Tauca) transformed into pure evaporite sequences.

Astrobiology Spectroscopy: In-situ Raman and UV fluorescence detection of extremophilic pigments, amino acids, and polycyclic aromatics.
Rotorcraft Flight: Atmospheric density is reduced by 35%-55%, providing natural low Reynolds number conditions for Mars helicopter blades.
Autonomous Navigation: Testing high-contrast illumination, shadow navigation, and hazard avoidance in unstructured rocky terrain.

analogs.name: Laguna Colorada (Eduardo Abaroa Reserve)
analogs.scientific_summary: Shallow hypersaline high-altitude volcanic lake characterized by blood-red pigmentation caused by extremophilic microalgae and Archaea surviving under lethal UV radiation, sub-zero temperatures, and toxic borax/arsenic brines. Foremost astrobiological analog for ancient Martian warm-spring lacustrine environments and biosignature preservation.

analogs.name: Sol de Mañana Geothermal Field
analogs.scientific_summary: High-energy geothermal field situated at nearly 5,000 meters elevation. Features boiling mud pools, pressurized steam fumaroles emitting sulfurous vapors, and acidic hydrothermal alteration minerals. Direct analog for early Mars hydrothermal systems, Gusev Crater 'Home Plate' silica sinter deposits, and Io's sulfur volcanism.
analogs.geological_context: Pleistocene to Holocene volcanic geothermal field with intense solfataric and sulfur mineral precipitation.
